movie.title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
movie.originalTitle: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
movie.overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished… As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY. Experience an intense immersion where every second counts with INCEPTION, an explosion of freedom and energy in the global hit BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS), and the pinnacle of refined charisma with Ice On My Teeth, now reimagined for the big screen. The world-class cinematic VR concert that captivated audiences around the globe has been fully refitted for cinemas, bringing ATEEZ's electrifying performances to life on the largest stage of all.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When their beloved fan base ATINY mysteriously disappears, K-pop group ATEEZ embarks on a dangerous journey through surreal, collapsing worlds to rescue them and restore light to the darkness.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After receiving a cryptic message in their hideout, ATEEZ discovers that ATINY has completely vanished, triggering a reality-bending shift in their world. To find their fans, the group must navigate treacherous landscapes, including burning wastelands and fog-shrouded cities, while constantly pursued by a shadowy threat. Reimagined as a cinematic experience, their fight to reunite with ATINY is set to electrifying performances of their hit tracks. Ultimately, the group relies on their signature energy, music, and unyielding bond to overcome the darkness.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The narrative begins in ATEEZ's peaceful hideout, where the group's normal life is abruptly shattered by the arrival of a mysterious, unexplainable message. Immediately following the message, the group makes the horrifying discovery that ATINY, their beloved fans and beacon of light, have vanished without a trace. Cast into a dreamlike state, ATEEZ finds themselves wandering through an eerie wasteland as their once-familiar world begins to collapse around them in flames. They are drawn into the Dark City, a metropolis shrouded in dense, suffocating fog, where danger lurks around every corner. Relentlessly pursued by an unknown, hostile force, the members must band together and actively fight back rather than succumb to despair. Each stage of their perilous quest corresponds to high-octane musical performances, blending narrative intrigue with their signature explosive choreography. From the emotional depth of INCEPTION to the chaotic freedom of BOUNCY and the sleek charisma of Ice On My Teeth, their music serves as their ultimate weapon against the darkness. As the boundaries of reality bend, ATEEZ pushes through every trial with absolute determination to bring ATINY back. This immersive, cinematic journey highlights the unbreakable connection between ATEEZ and their fans, delivering a high-stakes adventure where every second counts.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS brings the global K-pop powerhouse's acclaimed VR concert experience to the big screen in a fully refitted, cinematic spectacle. The story opens in the group's quiet sanctuary, which is suddenly upended when a mysterious message causes their fandom, ATINY, to disappear into thin air. Thrust into a series of surreal and perilous dimensions—from blazing wastelands to fog-dense urban landscapes—ATEEZ must outrun a sinister force to rescue those they care about most. Packed with reimagined performances of iconic hits like INCEPTION, BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS), and Ice On My Teeth, this immersive blend of dramatic narrative and world-class concert performance captures ATEEZ's electrifying stage presence and narrative depth.

story_structure.resolution: Through their resilience and performance, ATEEZ breaks the spell and lights the path forward to reunite with ATINY.
story_structure.introduction: ATEEZ enjoys a peaceful moment in their hideout until a mysterious message suddenly arrives, disrupting their calm reality.
story_structure.risingAction: Pursued by an unknown threat, ATEEZ navigates surreal and dangerous realms—from a dreamlike wasteland to a burning world—using powerful musical performances to fight back.

faq.answer: The dominant genre is a cinematic VR concert film and musical event, combining performance arts with fantasy and sci-fi visual narrative elements.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS?

faq.answer: No, it is not part of a traditional movie franchise. It is a standalone cinematic adaptation and expansion of ATEEZ's world-class VR concert experience.
faq.question: Is this movie part of a franchise?

faq.answer: Yes, cinema audiences can look forward to 20 minutes of exclusive, never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage included at the end of the feature presentation.
faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene in ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS?

faq.answer: The film stars the eight members of the global K-pop group ATEEZ: Hongjoong, Seonghwa, Yunho, Yeosang, San, Mingi, Wooyoung, and Jongho.
faq.question: Who are the main stars featured in the film?

faq.answer: The cinematic experience features reimagined performances of hit songs including INCEPTION, BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS), and Ice On My Teeth.
faq.question: What songs are featured in the movie?

faq.answer: The narrative follows ATEEZ after receiving a mysterious message at their hideout. Discovering that their fanbase (ATINY) has vanished, the group must journey through a dreamlike wasteland, a burning world, and a foggy Dark City while fighting unknown forces to find them.
faq.question: What is the storyline of the film?

faq.answer: Yes, it originated as an acclaimed cinematic VR concert experience that was specially refitted and re-mastered for traditional big-screen cinema viewing.
faq.question: Was this film originally shown in a different format?

faq.answer: Yes, as a concert and performance film, it is designed for general audiences and fans of all ages, though viewers sensitive to high-energy visuals should note that it contains dynamic sequence lighting.
faq.question: Is this film suitable for general audiences?

faq.answer: No prior knowledge is necessary. While fans (ATINY) will recognize thematic references to ATEEZ's overarching group universe, general viewers can enjoy the high-energy performances, music, and cinematic visuals on their own.
faq.question: Do viewers need prior knowledge of ATEEZ's storyline or lore to enjoy it?

faq.answer: The theatrical screening runs for approximately 1 hour and 5 minutes (65 minutes total), which includes the main cinematic concert feature and the exclusive behind-the-scenes content.
